messages:
Maya: Heads-up: sampleapp rerank flow failing on staging. Embeddings show dim mismatch between Go and Python clients.
Sam: Minimal repro?
Maya: Go batcher submits len=1536, python logs len=1537. Server rejects with 400: "expected dim 1536 got 1537".
Chen: Any chance of buffer mutation on retry? We recently changed re-slice logic in the Go batcher.
Maya: There were auth refresh retries around the same time (401 -> refresh -> retry). The two outbound POSTs had identical values array but different length fields: {"embedding":{"dim":1537,"vector_length":1536,"values":[...]}}
Sam: So two length keys conflict. Server code prefers dim and fails.
Chen: Go-sdk sets vector_length from internal buffer length; python sets dim from len(values). We should canonicalize.
Maya: Immediate fix: sampleapp will stop sending vector_length.
Sam: Longer-term: server must ignore client-declared dims and validate against len(values), returning clear error like "declared dim X != actual len Y". Also add e2e test.
Chen: I'll open a go-sdk PR to remove vector_length and add an assertion in the batcher to catch reslice bugs.
Olivia: sdk-bot created INF-4123 linking SDK teams and sampleapp repro.
sdk-bot: INF-4123 created: "embedding shape parity: dim vs vector_length"
Maya: Thanks, will paste PR links here when ready.
